title: "Flags"
format: html
echo: false
resources:
  - flags/*.png

```{r}
#| include: false
# Extract flag features (spatial color grid, color histogram, and aspect ratio)
py_code <- '
import glob, json, os
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image

features = []
for f in sorted(glob.glob("flags/*.png")):
    code = os.path.basename(f)[:-4]
    im = Image.open(f).convert("RGBA")
    w, h = im.size
    bg = Image.new("RGBA", im.size, (255, 255, 255, 255))
    rgb_im = Image.alpha_composite(bg, im).convert("RGB")
    
    small = np.asarray(rgb_im.resize((8, 6), Image.Resampling.BILINEAR), dtype=float) / 255.0
    grid = np.round(small.flatten(), 3).tolist()
    
    arr = np.asarray(rgb_im.resize((40, 30), Image.Resampling.NEAREST), dtype=float) / 255.0
    bins = np.floor(np.clip(arr * 3.999, 0, 3)).astype(int)
    idx = bins[:, :, 0] * 16 + bins[:, :, 1] * 4 + bins[:, :, 2]
    hist = np.bincount(idx.flatten(), minlength=64) / float(idx.size)
    palette = np.round(hist, 3).tolist()
    
    features.append({
        "code": code,
        "aspect": round(w / float(h), 3),
        "grid": grid,
        "palette": palette
    })

print(json.dumps(features))
'

flag_data <- jsonlite::fromJSON(system2("python3", c("-c", shQuote(py_code)), stdout = TRUE), simplifyVector = FALSE)
ojs_define(flag_data = flag_data)
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
regionNames = new Intl.DisplayNames(["en"], { type: "region" })
ukNames = ({
  "gb-eng": "England",
  "gb-nir": "Northern Ireland",
  "gb-sct": "Scotland",
  "gb-wls": "Wales"
})

flagLabel = (code) => ukNames[code] ?? regionNames.of(code.toUpperCase())

euclidean = (a, b) => {
  let sum = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < a.length; i++) {
    const d = a[i] - b[i];
    sum += d * d;
  }
  return Math.sqrt(sum / a.length);
}

flagDistance = (f1, f2, metric) => {
  const layoutDist = euclidean(f1.grid, f2.grid);
  const colorDist = euclidean(f1.palette, f2.palette) * 3.5;
  const shapeDist = Math.abs(f1.aspect - f2.aspect);

  if (metric === "Combined") return 0.55 * layoutDist + 0.35 * colorDist + 0.10 * shapeDist;
  if (metric === "Layout") return layoutDist;
  if (metric === "Color") return colorDist;
  return shapeDist + 0.01 * colorDist;
}

selectedObj = flag_data.find(d => d.code === selectedFlag)

rankedFlags = flag_data
  .filter(d => d.code !== selectedFlag)
  .map(d => ({
    ...d,
    name: flagLabel(d.code),
    dist: flagDistance(selectedObj, d, similarityMetric)
  }))
  .sort((a, b) => a.dist - b.dist)

closest3 = rankedFlags.slice(0, 3)
distant3 = rankedFlags.slice(-3).reverse()
```

```{ojs}
viewof selectedFlag = Inputs.select(flag_data.map(d => d.code), {
  label: "Flag",
  format: flagLabel,
  sort: true,
  value: "us"
})

viewof similarityMetric = Inputs.radio(
  ["Combined", "Layout", "Color", "Shape"],
  {
    label: "Match",
    value: "Combined"
  }
)
```

    `)}

</div>
